SET @prov_c := '%s'; SET @id:= '%s'; SET @cat_id := '%s'; SET @send := IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2); SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1); SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001'); SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930'); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_rdu14( id varchar(32) NOT NULL, hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL, areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL, flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL, date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL, b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL, target int(9) DEFAULT 0, result int(9) DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year), KEY (hospcode), KEY (areacode), KEY (b_year) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8; DELETE FROM s_rdu14 WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543); DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS t_ht_rdu ; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t_ht_rdu( min_date_serv date, max_date_serv date, g_diagcode text, g_code text, d_code text, d_nsaid text, min_date_nsaid date, egfr_b DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT NULL, egfr_b_date DATE DEFAULT NULL, result DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid), KEY(hospcode,pid) ) ENGINE=myisam IGNORE AS SELECT o.HOSPCODE,o.PID ,SUBSTR(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.date_serv ORDER BY o.date_serv ASC),1,10) min_date_serv ,SUBSTR(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.date_serv ORDER BY o.date_serv DESC),1,10) max_date_serv ,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.diagcode ORDER BY o.date_serv ASC ) g_diagcode ,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT('{"DATE_SERV":"',o.date_serv,'","DIAGCODE":"',o.diagcode ,'","DIAGTYPE":"',o.diagtype,'"}') ORDER BY o.date_serv SEPARATOR '
,') as g_code ,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT('{"DATE_SERV":"',d.date_serv,'","DIDSTD":"',d.didstd,'","DNAME":"',d.dname,'","AMOUNT":"',d.amount,'"}') ORDER BY d.date_serv SEPARATOR '
,') as d_code ,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT IF( d.CHK_NSAID='Y' AND d.CHK_ASA='N' AND d.scount=1 ,CONCAT('{"DATE_SERV":"',d.date_serv,'","DIDSTD":"',d.didstd,'","DNAME":"',d.dname,'","AMOUNT":"',d.amount,'"}') ,NULL) ORDER BY d.date_serv SEPARATOR '
,') as d_nsaid ,SUBSTR(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT IF( d.CHK_NSAID='Y' AND d.CHK_ASA='N' AND d.scount=1,d.date_serv,NULL) ORDER BY d.date_serv ASC),1,10) as min_date_nsaid ,NULL as egfr_b,NULL as egfr_b_date ,ROUND(n.egfr_r1,2) egfr,n.egfr_d1 as egfr_date ,0 as result FROM tmp_diag_opd o INNER JOIN chospital h ON o.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,15) INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON o.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND o.PID=p.PID INNER JOIN tmp_drug_asu d ON o.hospcode=d.HOSPCODE AND o.PID=d.PID AND o.SEQ=d.SEQ AND o.DATE_SERV=d.DATE_SERV AND d.amount > 0 LEFT JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid WHERE ( SUBSTR(o.diagcode,1,4) IN('N183' ,'N184','N185') OR ( (SUBSTR(o.diagcode,1,4) IN('N189','E102', 'E112', 'E122', 'E132', 'E142', 'I151') OR SUBSTR(o.diagcode,1,3) IN('I12', 'I13')) AND n.egfr_r1 <60) ) AND o.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d GROUP BY o.HOSPCODE,o.PID; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r4,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d4 WHERE n.egfr_d4 <= o.min_date_nsaid AND n.egfr_r4<60; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r3,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d3 WHERE n.egfr_d3 <= o.min_date_nsaid AND n.egfr_r3<60; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r2,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d2 WHERE n.egfr_d2 <= o.min_date_nsaid AND n.egfr_r2<60; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r1,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d1 WHERE n.egfr_d1 <= o.min_date_nsaid AND n.egfr_r1<60; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r4,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d4 WHERE n.egfr_d4 <= o.min_date_serv AND n.egfr_r4<60 AND ISNULL(egfr_b) ; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r3,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d3 WHERE n.egfr_d3 <= o.min_date_serv AND n.egfr_r3<60 AND ISNULL(egfr_b) ; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r2,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d2 WHERE n.egfr_d2 <= o.min_date_serv AND n.egfr_r2<60 AND ISNULL(egfr_b) ; UPDATE t_ht_rdu o INNER JOIN t_ckd_egfr n ON o.hospcode=n.hospcode AND o.pid=n.pid SET o.egfr_b=n.egfr_r1,o.egfr_b_date=n.egfr_d1 WHERE n.egfr_d1 <= o.min_date_serv AND n.egfr_r1<60 AND ISNULL(egfr_b) ; UPDATE t_ht_rdu SET result=1 WHERE min_date_nsaid IS NOT NULL AND ( INSTR(g_diagcode,'N183') OR INSTR(g_diagcode,'N184') OR INSTR(g_diagcode,'N185') OR egfr_b <60 ); INSERT IGNORE INTO s_rdu14 ( SELECT @id,d.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode ,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year ,COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(d.hospcode,'-',d.pid)) target ,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(d.result IN(1), CONCAT(d.hospcode,'-',d.pid),NULL)) result FROM t_ht_rdu d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode=h.hoscode GROUP BY hoscode );

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") "target" ,SUM("result") "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
